quarterly_data.quarter: Schrödinger press release: Schrdinger Announces Licensing and Collaboration Agreement (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Schrödinger announced the formation of Tectora, a new biotechnology company it co-founded with New Enterprise Associates (NEA) and RA Capital Management to develop immunology and inflammation therapies, and a licensing and collaboration agreement with it: Schrödinger contributed two early-stage small molecule programs (SDGR-4594 and SDGR-8139) and in exchange received an equity stake in Tectora and is eligible to receive future milestones and royalties. Tectora will partner with Schrödinger's drug discovery experts and leverage Schrödinger's computational platform at scale to advance these programs to clinical candidates.
quarterly_data.figure: two early-stage programs (SDGR-4594, SDGR-8139) licensed for an equity stake plus eligibility for future milestones and royalties
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: licensee and platform collaborator (company co-founded by Schrödinger)
